  1. opennlp.tools.document

Packages that use opennlp.tools.document
Package
Description
opennlp.tools.document
 
  • Classes in opennlp.tools.document used by opennlp.tools.document
    Class
    Description
    Annotation
    One annotation of a Document: a typed value anchored to a Span of the document's original text, or a span-less value under a document-scoped key.
    Document
    An offset-anchored annotation container: the original text of one document plus any number of typed annotation layers over it.
    Document.DuplicateLayerPolicy
    How Document.merge(Document, DuplicateLayerPolicy) treats a layer key that is present on both documents.
    DocumentAnalyzer
    Runs a fixed sequence of annotators over a text, producing one Document that carries every step's layers.
    DocumentAnalyzer.Builder
    Assembles a DocumentAnalyzer from annotators in execution order.
    DocumentAnnotator
    A pipeline step that reads layers from a Document and returns a new document with its own layers added.
    DocumentAnnotators.SentenceTokenConsumer
    Receives one sentence's contiguous token run during DocumentAnnotators.forEachSentence(List, List, SentenceTokenConsumer).
    LayerKey
    Identifies one annotation layer of a Document and carries the type of that layer's annotation values, so reading a layer back is statically typed.
    LayerKey.Scope
    How the annotations of a layer relate to the document text.
